sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 2009
sections.section: RULE - Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act 2009
sections.description:
ACT VII OF 2010
ACT VII OF 2010
PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY
TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009
An Act further to amend the Punjab
Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary,
20th July, 2010]
No.PAP-Legis.2(41)/2010/252,
dated 20-7-2010.---The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill,
2010, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on
12th July, 2010, and assented to by the
Governor of the Punjab on 19th July, 2010, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas, it is
expedient further to amend the Punjab
Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment)
Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come
into force on the first day of January, 2010.
2. Amendment in
section 7 of the Act V of 1958.--In
the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958), in section 7, in
subsection (1), clause (a) shall be substituted by the following:
"(a) reduce or extend the interval which would
otherwise elapse between the coming into
force of any two successive valuation lists for any rating area, or where a
valuation list has been lost or destroyed
by operation of circumstances beyond control, cancel the list, direct the preparation
of a new list and order recovery of pending tax to be made on the basis either
of the last preceding valuation list or of the new list; and"
